name: shaughv-tasks
description: Emmett Shaughnessy's standalone Codex task + workplace-memory skill bundle. Seven SHAUGHV tasks-* skills stand up a self-contained .tasks/ board and memory in any repo: dated milestones, prerequisites/owners, compact typed task handoffs, explicit functional/evidence finish lines, preservation invariants, authoritative oracles, conditional evidence receipts and causal attempt ledgers, authorized-only waivers, qualification tasks for milestone outcomes, progressive working slices, and bounded route audits. A project-named localhost dashboard runs on a zero-dependency identity-verified Node server; boards may be git-shared or local, with a gitignored secure/ tier. Tasks remain model-neutral and resumable across sessions, operators, Claude, Codex, and other agents without transcript dumps or false completion from missing evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Emmett's standalone task + workplace-memory skill bundle.
interface.longDescription: Run /tasks-start to stand up a self-contained .tasks/ board and workplace memory with a live localhost dashboard. /tasks-create adds scoped milestones/tasks/subtasks with model-neutral contracts, default Verification, conditional Evidence receipts and Attempts, preservation invariants, authoritative oracles, and truthful bounded outcomes. Missing required evidence remains open rather than becoming an agent waiver; milestone qualification children protect epic outcomes. /tasks-update surfaces semantic stagnation and unsupported completion as well as stale work. Secrets stay out of tasks/memory. Skills-only; the board is a local Node server, not MCP.
defaultPrompt: Run /tasks-start to set up my task board and workplace memory.
Use /tasks-create to add scoped work with an explicit finish line, authoritative evidence, and resumable state.
Use /tasks-update to sync and triage my tasks and fill memory gaps.
Use /tasks-remove to fold my tasks memory back into the repo.
